clips.title: The story
paras: In Dun Garok, Shindigger Stout fills the dwarves’ kegs and draws interest from Tarren Mill. The Royal Apothecary Society wants the ale for a purpose far darker than drink.

Dwarves of Ironforge hold Dun Garok in the southeastern Hillsbrad Foothills. Within its barracks and mess halls, defenders share Shindigger Stout through the cold and the siege against their regional enemies. The brew is a staple of the garrison’s daily life.
